title: NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.01549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. translated_title: NashDreamer：面向零和不完全信息博弈的基于模型的强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在单智能体领域已取得显著成果，但其在竞争性不完全信息博弈（IIGs）中的扩展仍未得到充分探索。在多智能体环境中，对手引发的非平稳性使学习过程变得复杂，而去中心化的模型学习面临严重的可辨识性障碍——我们认为这使得集中式模型学习成为一种数学上的必然选择。基于这一分析，我们提出了NashDreamer，一个针对双人零和不完全信息博弈的原则性MBRL框架。该框架引入了一个集中式的多智能体循环状态空间模型（MARSSM），将环境动态与玩家策略对其个体观测的影响解耦。NashDreamer被设计为可以使用任意策略梯度算法，并在理想化模型下继承其向纳什均衡收敛的保证。在四个基准博弈上的实证评估表明，N（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: NashDreamer提出了一个面向双人零和不完全信息博弈的基于模型强化学习框架，通过集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型（MARSSM）解耦环境动态与策略对观测的影响，并可结合任意策略梯度算法，在理想化模型下继承其向纳什均衡收敛的理论保证。
en_tdlr: NashDreamer is a principled model-based reinforcement learning framework for two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games, featuring a centralized multi-agent recurrent state-space model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from strategy-induced observations, and can leverage arbitrary policy gradient algorithms while inheriting their Nash equilibrium convergence guarantees under an idealized model.
